1. Case Summary

This report consolidates the reconciled, approval-gated forensic findings for the multi-host APT intrusion tracked as SRL-2015-APT-ENTERPRISE. The campaign spans 4 acquired hosts (disk + memory images) processed through the Agentropix-SIFT Trinity pipeline. Aggregate raw findings total 2,233; ~2,874 evidence documents are live on Wazuh. Of those, 17 high-signal findings have been reviewed and approved for this report, and 109 indicators were enriched against VirusTotal + AlienVault OTX, confirming 12 malicious indicators.
